profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Procore Technologies
profile.summary: Software Engineer working for over 2.5 years, with experience in Typescript, Javascript, Python, MongoDB, Java, SQL, Vue.js, Node.js, Docker and AWS. Graduated from the University of Florida in 2019.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Engineered REST APIs used by two client facing web applications and one internal administrative portal.
• Converted internal node package used by all repositories to TypeScript/TypeGoose, resulting in a reduction of bugs.
• Reduced CI/CD pipeline build times by 45% in the team's largest repository.
• Reconstructed scraping tool to support an additional framework on the code side and designed the docker image deployed as a Lambda.
• Leveraged knowledge: TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, Docker, Vue.js, Serverless, MongoDB

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
•	Improved user experience on browser support page by redesigning the page and developing a better browser recognition engine.
•	Competed in a company-wide hackathon, created an automatic budget builder that significantly reduced budget creation time for users.
•	Investigated and resolved several backlogged bugs in a large codebase for a product used by 18 million users.
•	Leveraged knowledge in Frontend Web Development, JavaScript, Git, and debugged using Chrome Developer Tools.

positions.title: Captain (Software Engineering)
positions.description:
•	Overhauled the frontend by utilizing A/B testing resulting in 55% higher user engagement across the app.
•	Leveraged knowledge in Mobile Development, Swift, Git, Xcode, and Firebase.

positions.title: Programming Intern
positions.description:
•	Designed and composed well designed SQL reports for 10 clients.
•	Mastered the use of Git in a professional setting.
